name: fever-evaluation-v1
sampling: Sort dev by ID; exclude all recorded usage and normalized text matches to the full official train pool or used claims; deduplicate candidates; shuffle each label with Random(0); allocate 300 calibration then 1000 holdout per label; shuffle each set.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold and whitespace collapse, compared directly during selection only. No per-claim hashes are stored. Near-duplicates and entity/page-disjointness are not claimed.

policy.training: Keep official train available for verifier and controller training; never train on calibration or holdout IDs. Runtime leakage guards compare FEVER IDs.
policy.development: Keep the historical 900 unchanged. Previously inspected dev claims remain development data, including smoke-test extras.
policy.calibration: Fit confidence adjustments only; do not use for verifier/controller weights or policy/prompt selection.
policy.holdout: Evaluate finalized configurations only; no training, teacher-target generation, prompt tuning, or failure-driven policy changes. If used for development, retire/version this holdout.
policy.scope: Unused in available project records at freeze time; no guarantee about unrecorded external runs or pretrained-model exposure.
policy.labels: Class-balanced evaluation; report this sampling scheme, since precision and calibration depend on class prevalence.
